title: Longer climbs on reordered exclusion sums for a conditional κ = 4.136014808e-5 bound
body:
Under the inherited analytic and fixed finite-alphabet multitape hypotheses,

$$T(n)=O(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}),\qquad\kappa=\frac{4136014808}{10^{14}}=4.136014808\times10^{-5}>2^{-15}.$$

This is **0.15973% above PR #50** (Rohan Gupta, `4129418696/10^14`), **0.29455% above #49**, and **0.42221% above #48**. The exact bit saving is `4136185882/10^14`. These are conditional asymptotic exponent comparisons, not measured speedups or a global-best claim.

**Full `make verify` PASSED locally** at research commit `8e097ccfe34763092d68f4dd03ffdaf9513ef478`: **192 tests**, five new focused tests, fresh changed-producer/profile and full physical dirty-basis replay, inherited full data geometry with exact fallback recovery, and **18 historical patch checks**. Completed 2026-10-08T16:30:23.656527+00:00 in 443.9 seconds. [Validation receipt](https://github.com/rohanarun/integer-mult-bounds/blob/research/climbed-48-v2/research/climbed-48/validation.json); log SHA256 `c8823c840e050e2c87f8a830cf91b07fd25b2d24f4070f1a6d04bc003c5ca429`. The earlier #49 receipt is preserved separately. Follow-up changes are documentation and receipt metadata only.

## What changed

Longer Daytona hill climbs on PR #48's summand and leave-one-out orders, using the pinned adjacent-swap `tbits` and `vbits` representation from #49, yield new legal carrier-use lists and lower role counts.

| Quantity | PR #50 | This PR |
|---|---:|---:|
| h23 roles | 36,297 | **36,203** |
| h25 roles | 48,201 | **48,148** |
| Width W | 176,993,671 | **176,683,608** |

The new pinned matchings retain 6,396 carriers at h23 and 8,000 at h25. The original-envelope labels, fixed I+J bases, copied centers, paid endpoint corrections, reversed data geometry with exact fallback recovery, complex layer and balanced assembly remain inherited.

The optimizer uses floating-point logarithmic weights and SciPy assignment. The selected finite witness is checked independently with exact arithmetic. No exact weighted-matching optimality or global optimality claim is made; the README now explicitly distinguishes numerical search from exact checking of the pinned witness.

## Checks

The independent local focused replay verifies scalar identities, dense support audits, admissible pinned links, independent recounts, complete physical timelines and dirty basis vectors in both orientations, with zero CRT disagreements. The exact certificate checks all 47 strict constraints and seven margins, rejects the next grid points, and excludes the retained #40–#50 comparison networks at the new bit saving, including #50's complete child list.

Run `make climbed-48-verify`; the broader check is `make verify`. Finite replay is not formal verification or external acceptance of the inherited all-size analytic and physical interfaces.
